finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: num is very large, causing sprintf to write beyond the bounds of buffer
finding.assumptions: The size of buffer is fixed at 50, and there is no check to ensure that the formatted string fits within this buffer. If num is very large, the formatted string could exceed 50 characters, leading to a buffer overflow.

finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: formattedNum contains attacker-controlled data that could be crafted to inject malicious commands
finding.assumptions: The code does not sanitize or validate the input before using it in printf. If an attacker can control the input to format_with_commas, they could potentially inject malicious commands.
